description.value:
House-rule proposal (still to be agreed with the player). In any moment of fear or stress a tiny, harmless, but always visible effect escapes her: a gust of wind, a drop in temperature, a bud opening, glass fogging over.

No roll, no cost, no action. The point is not mechanics — the point is that someone in the room can see it.

With the ring worn, the effect is always winter-coloured.
